text:
maria: Putting a compact 1-pager up for review that combines SLA bullets, a three-line deploy decision flow, and a micro-bench (median / 99th / $/k tokens). Link: https://drive.redwood/enterprise/pocket_v2

doug: Saw it. Please make the SLA bullets scannable for an AE on a 10-min call. Suggested format: Mode | 99th (seq<=512) | Uptime SLO.

han: Also add a single-line fallback example: Hosted -> (auto) Dedicated -> Private. Use an emoji arrow row to keep it visual on one line.

sam: For the bench, keep numbers rounded and call out knobs that change them (batching, quant, KV cache). Field needs quick answers.

maria: Done — bench shows ~40ms median, ~180ms 99th on Hosted baseline, cost estimate ~$0.06/k tokens. Added a tiny note: "quant/ batching may reduce cost by 30-60% depending on workload."

doug: Copy tweaks: CISO one-liner should emphasize audit logs and private peering. Platform lead one-liner should call out predictable P99 and autoscale policies.

han: Drafted inbound routing rules in the doc: tag by industry + deploy interest + urgency. Example: fintech + private + rfp => route solutions-enterprise; priority: rfp.

sam: Webinar idea: "How to guarantee inference SLAs without owning every GPU". Segment plan: 20m bench + 15m deployment playbook + 20m Q&A. Include 2 short demos: failover routing & cost dashboard.

maria: I'll prep the slide-ready one-pager and two 90s demo scripts. Can design export the onepager to PNG for slides? @design please confirm.

publish-bot: build-bot: asset export complete: pocket_v2.pdf (hash: d4e5f6), slides_preview.png (hash: a1b2c3).

doug: Final ask: everyone review Drive doc comments by 4pm PT. If no objections, we seed invites to top 40 inbound leads and publish a short launch post on the blog linking the one-pager and webinar sign-up. :rocket:
